posts.author: battousai
posts.content:
The longer it takes for them to announce who Islam is fighting leads me to believe its probably not gonna be on this card. Islam is probably gonna fight in Vegas or NYC closer to the end of the year if I had to guess. I think thats why were now hearing "rumors" that Morales is gonna get a shot over Garry. I think thats just all noise and Garry is clearly gonna get rhe next shot. They have to save something interesting to close out the year. Between the White house card and IFW the UFC has a lot of big draws already booked this summer.

I think the UFC will probably build at least two cards this fall around fights for Islam and Kayla.  I actually wouldnt be surprised at all if this card has both Volk/Evloev and Merab/Yan on it. They need to get those two divisions moving and I think the UFC would probably feel better about putting Evloev in a headliner if its paired with another title fight. If its not this card I could see Evloev/Volk being paired with Shevchenko/Silva on a card in the fall.

I still think Yan/Merab will be on this card as the main or co main though.
